decisions.reason: Step 5.1 asserted a false coefficient conversion: with v_i=u_i/||u_i||, <f,v_i>v_i=(<f,u_i>/||u_i||^2)u_i. At L=4, f=c_0=1, ||c_0||=2 and the normalized coefficient is 2, so multiplying it by 2 yields 4c_0 rather than c_0. Repaired with the exact identity and division rule; the Statement and its already-established completeness claims are unchanged. The fatal type is logic because the displayed expansion inference was false, not a missing citation. Also corrected squared-norm terminology in step 2.3.

Clause (b) used E=B=0 in the conductor to replace the D,H jumps by minus the filling traces. That does not follow: def-em-polarization-magnetization(d) gives D=P and H=-M when E=B=0, with no constitutive relation fixing P,M. The stationary-jump supplier concludes sigma_f=n dot(D_cond-D_fill), K_f=n cross(H_cond-H_fill); I repaired the definition to use these general readings and to make the filling-only formulas conditional on D_cond=H_cond=0. The fatal type is logic because the missing conductor-side assumption makes the original inference invalid.

The original TE H_z=h_mn and TM E_z=e_mn assigned dimensionless profiles to SI field quantities with units A/m and V/m, without a numerical-component convention. This is a physical quantity/unit interface defect (other), rather than a wrong curl calculation or missing dependency citation. Added positive real longitudinal amplitude quantities H_* (A/m) and E_* (V/m) to both field pairs and explicit units for all parameters. The proof uses scaled real profiles, so each linear eigen/divergence/curl/trace identity holds unchanged. Also repaired the nonfatal cutoff parenthetical: TE H_t and TM E_t vanish at beta=0, while both complete field pairs remain nonzero.
